description: Creates a thought and sets its note, type, tags and aliases in the same call. Call it when adding something new. Always supply parentId — a thought with no links gets lost in the graph. Search first: a suitable thought may already exist, in which case extending it is the better move.

aliases.description: Alternate names that TheBrain's search matches too. Saving a brain's first alias makes that brain require TheBrain 15.0.621 or later on every device, so write aliases only when the user wants them in this brain.

brainId.description: Brain identifier. Take it from brain_list — never guess it.

name.description: Thought title. Short and to the point.

parentId.description: What to attach it to. Without this the thought is left orphaned. Not a type: a thought made under one would get that type and no parent, so a type goes in typeId. Not a tag either: that goes in tagIds.

relation.description: How the new thought relates to that one. Child by default. For a sibling of a thought, give that thought's parent as parentId. Refused without parentId.

name: brain_create_thought
